title: Lower Power: Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Back Squat 3 → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Squat @ RPE 8 · DBs 15–25% bodyweight · rest 3:00 · max intent
Low hurdles, quick off the floor

cond.subtitle: All-out sprints, full recovery
items: Assault bike or Treadmill Sprint: 20 sec all-out

note: Same squat weight is fine. Make the jumps higher and the DBs a little heavier.
